newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: MOTOR RACING-BERGER RESTING AFTER SINUS OPERATION.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-BERGER RESTING AFTER SINUS OPERATION.

text.p: Benetton driver Gerhard Berger was recovering at home in Monaco on Friday from recent surgery for an inflamed sinus.
"I will rest for another week and then I hope to be in the best shape for the Canadian Grand Prix, " said Berger. The Montreal race is scheduled for June 15.
The operation forced the Austrian to scrap recent test sessions at Barcelona and Silverstone.
